title: Northstar Insurance claim H-48291 document request

structured_fields.deadline: Upload the requested documents by June 17, 2026 to avoid review delays.
structured_fields.upload_instructions: Upload documents in the Northstar claims portal under claim H-48291, or ask the representative to send a secure upload link by SMS or email.
structured_fields.escalation_instructions: If the portal is unavailable or the claimant needs help, request a claims advocate callback and reference escalation code HOME-DOCS.
approved_phrasing: The claim is pending because Northstar still needs damage photos and a licensed contractor repair estimate.
Northstar asks that the documents be uploaded by June 17, 2026 to keep the review moving.
Documents can be uploaded in the claims portal under claim H-48291, or the representative can send a secure upload link.

chunks.text: For claim H-48291, Northstar Insurance needs damage photos and a licensed contractor repair estimate before the adjuster can continue review.
Upload documents in the Northstar claims portal under claim H-48291. If the caller cannot use the portal, ask the representative to send a secure upload link by SMS or email.
Northstar requests the damage photos and repair estimate by June 17, 2026. Missing the date does not close the claim, but it may delay review.
If the portal is unavailable or the claimant needs help, request a claims advocate callback and reference escalation code HOME-DOCS.
